name: savvycal
label: SavvyCal
description: Scheduling tool that lets invitees overlay their calendar when picking a time.

list_events.label: List Events
list_events.description: Returns a list of scheduled meetings from your SavvyCal account.

states.label: State
states.description: Filter events by their current status. Leave empty to return all statuses.

start_after.label: Start After
start_after.description: Only return events that start after this date and time.

start_before.label: Start Before
start_before.description: Only return events that start before this date and time.

team_id.label: Team
team_id.description: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.

link_ids.label: Scheduling Links
link_ids.description: Only return events booked through the selected scheduling links. Leave empty for all links.

limit.label: Maximum Results
limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Leave empty to return all matching events.

find_events_by_email.label: Find Events by Attendee Email
find_events_by_email.description: Returns all events where the attendee's email matches the given address.

attendee_email.label: Attendee Email
attendee_email.description: The email address of the attendee to search for.

start_after.label: Start After
start_after.description: Only search events starting after this date. Use this to limit the search scope and improve performance.

start_before.label: Start Before
start_before.description: Only search events starting before this date.

list_scheduling_links.label: List Scheduling Links
list_scheduling_links.description: Returns all scheduling links configured in your SavvyCal account.

team_id.label: Team
team_id.description: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.

list_workflows.label: List Workflows
list_workflows.description: Returns all workflows configured in your SavvyCal account.
